aqualishAquala.name: Aqualish (Aquala)
aqualishAquala.note: Brawl and Resilience ranks are included. Aquatic movement and cold/wet adaptation are resolved narratively.
aqualishAquala.source: Complete Species Guide v6 · fan profile · p.23

aqualishQuara.name: Aqualish (Quara)
aqualishQuara.note: Brawl and Coercion ranks are included. Aquatic movement and outdoor tracking adaptation are resolved narratively.
aqualishQuara.source: Complete Species Guide v6 · fan profile · p.23

aqualishUalaq.name: Aqualish (Ualaq)
aqualishUalaq.note: Brawl rank is included; choose Survival or Perception. Aquatic movement and vision adaptation are resolved narratively.
aqualishUalaq.source: Complete Species Guide v6 · fan profile · p.23

devaronian.name: Devaronian
devaronian.note: Deception and Survival ranks are included. Multiple Livers gives three boosts to poison-related Resilience checks; resolve that situational bonus narratively.
devaronian.source: Complete Species Guide v6 · fan profile · p.75

neimoidian.name: Neimoidian
neimoidian.note: Choose Deception or Negotiation for the included species rank.
neimoidian.source: Complete Species Guide v6 · fan profile · p.190

quarren.name: Quarren
quarren.note: Negotiation rank is included. Aquatic movement and humid/dry adaptation are resolved narratively.
quarren.source: Complete Species Guide v6 · fan profile · p.220

rattataki.name: Rattataki
rattataki.note: Choose Ranged (Heavy) or Ranged (Light) for the included species rank.
rattataki.source: Complete Species Guide v6 · fan profile · p.227

selkath.name: Selkath
selkath.note: Choose Coercion or Medicine. Surgeon adds one wound healed with successful Medicine treatment. Aquatic movement and humid/dry adaptation are resolved narratively.
selkath.source: Complete Species Guide v6 · fan profile · p.245
